kl.rule: per position, the KL divergence in nats between the reference's and the engine's distributions over: each token both lists of the top_k most probable tokens hold, and one outcome for every other token; at most the KL over the whole vocabulary. A rest mass below rest_floor is left out on the reference's side and taken as rest_floor on the engine's. A prompt's value is the mean over its positions

measure.alignment: row t is computed after the prompt and the first t tokens of the reference reply and predicts reply token t, t from 0
measure.failed_prompt: scores 0 and is listed with its cause
measure.label: computed by the system's own code on the reference reply, not by the proved computation
measure.seed_rule: FI-4's seed rule over the ids prefixed teacher_forced/: first 8 bytes, big-endian, of sha256(randomness || 0x00 || utf8(teacher_forced/a) || 0x00 || utf8(teacher_forced/b))
